name: Site Feedback Notifier
description: Hourly: emails the fleet operator every new reader feedback submission each subscribed site stored (the FeedbackWidget's /api/feedback rows). One instance serves all sites; sites subscribe in config/site-feedback-notifier-config.json by_site. Read-only on site databases. Never calls an LLM.

metadata.owner_note: owner is empty on purpose: AgentBase then sends a failed run's email to AGENT_DEFAULT_OWNER_EMAIL (the fleet operator). Feedback emails go to OPERATOR_EMAIL / OPERATOR_FROM_EMAIL.
